en.html:
The Stable Guard: in short, the Ashikaga house’s personal guard. The whole Rokuhara shogunate tended toward private ownership, but the Stable Guard was considered a particularly concentrated example.

They were said to have conducted numerous clandestine operations. Their commander, whatever his formal position, must possess considerable influence behind the scenes.

Having decided to remain in Fudaraku for the present, I could scarcely ignore him.

I was about to speak when he did so first.
